intent: Independently audit the exact requested prompt/history refinement and the focused comparison before model calls.
reviewer: /root/history_refinement_audit; did not author prompt, implementation, runner, cases, or plan
verdict: clear for focused diagnostic; not full behavior acceptance or live product verification

grounding.assessment: The requested refinement changes model context and a rationale length instruction. It does not redefine mastery, disclosure eligibility, target meanings, or constitutional priorities. Persisted rationale supplies historical model evidence, not authority to override learner answers. Existing behavior requirements still govern outputs.

verified: Independently executed request equality for all nine preceding cases: current runtime candidate equals frozen-v3 task_meaning request with only both literal At most 40 words of phrases removed.
Baseline initial requests are the preceding frozen task_meaning arm, not an older weaker candidate.
The candidate uses the same runtime history formatter as product code and adds actual generated reason, decision, and response on turn two.
Historical tutor messages without recorded model metadata are not supplied fabricated rationales.
Human-reviewed runtime edits preserve original generated output and actual posted wording separately; unused suggestions are excluded from delivered history.
Judge inputs include actual posted dialogue and learner-facing response, excluding private reason/decision.
Six cases, two arms, three repetitions and two turns produce 72 target slots; three metrics produce 216 judgment slots.
The followup Okay is explicitly a synthetic continuation and is not treated as new learner mastery.
No case-specific target prompt rule, expected-answer lookup, keyword semantic grading, or answer leakage was found.
Prior independent review identifies the selected gift/library/overlap/agreement failure boundaries and contradiction/all-complete controls.
Model settings, token budgets, retries, concurrency, raw preservation, and resume checks are declared. Failed calibration cannot establish acceptance.
limitations: Turn one has no newly generated structured history, so it tests only removal of the reason word cap.
Turn two combines uncapped reason with each arm's own prior generated text, so causal effects of history and rationale length are not isolated.
Repeated generations are six exposed scenarios, not independent unseen cases; no generalization or learning-outcome claim is supported.
Actual persisted feedback permissions and browser request behavior require separate product verification; the experiment bypasses the database read boundary.
The inherited judge previously disagreed with independent semantic review. Current output review remains necessary even if calibration passes.
followups_before_freeze: Pin imported prior runner.cjs containing parseJudge in source snapshots for reproducibility.
Resolve imported helper shebang handling against CRA build requirements; this is product compilation, not a semantic change.

unused_initial_frozen_review.candidate_review: clear for diagnostic at exact initial prompt/history hashes above

supplementary_dependency_pin.purpose: Imported parseJudge implementation is not included in frozen.sources; this independently verified commit/hash supplements the snapshot.

unused_initial_frozen_review.runtime_build_note: Imported helper shebang handling remains an implementation verification question. It does not block the Node-based diagnostic; do not equate harness success with browser delivery.

final_frozen_review.verification: Independently asserted deep equality of cases, initial request shells, settings, metrics, rubrics, judge prompts/procedures, calibration cases/examples, repetitions, turns, and followup between initial and v2 freeze. V2 pins the imported prior runner dependency and uses commented helper shebang. Both preparation followups are resolved without changing scientific inputs. Initial freeze was not used for model calls.
